Encounter fields audited by creature role: solitary hunters and dragons appear alone, pack and herd species carry pack- and herd-sized appearing values (Triceratops, Elephant and Mammoth intentionally herd at their tier), mounts and livestock use working-stock counts, and swarms are one creature by policy.
